tools.name: factrail_capabilities
tools.description: Use when you need to discover what FACTRAIL can verify or assess before calling another tool. Returns available capabilities, inputs, fields, sources, versions, and limitations; call first to inspect current coverage and source state.

tools.name: factrail_assess
tools.description: Use when you need a source-backed assessment of importing a product into the EU (tariff classification, duties, and related evidence). Returns an EvidenceEnvelope; import assessment is Beta and results expose source coverage and support levels.

tools.name: factrail_verify
tools.description: Use when you need verified, source-backed facts about a French company from its SIREN or SIRET. Returns Evidence with provenance, freshness, coverage, conflicts, and a reusable receipt.

tools.name: factrail_get_receipt
tools.description: Use when you need to re-fetch or audit a previously returned FACTRAIL result by its receipt ID. Recomputes the stored EvidenceEnvelope's content hash and rejects altered content; this checks integrity, not truth.

tools.name: verify_french_company
tools.description: Deprecated: use factrail_verify instead. Use when an older integration still expects the legacy flat French company lookup by SIREN/SIRET; kept callable for compatibility only.

tools.name: assess_import
tools.description: Deprecated: use factrail_assess instead. Use when an older integration still expects the legacy beta EU import assessment format; coverage may be partial or provisional and this is not a binding customs result.

tools.name: analyze_company
tools.description: Deprecated: use factrail_verify instead. Use only when an older integration still calls this experimental tool; financial and credit data sources are unavailable and returned fields are null.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "factrail_capabilities" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use when you need to discover what FACTRAIL can verify or assess before calling another tool. Returns available capabilities, inputs, fields, sources, versions,…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify_french_company" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
